name: Plex-Notifier
description: Plex Notifier periodically checks for new Plex episodes and sends user-specific email alerts based on their watch history, powered by Tautulli. ✅ Supports per-user unsubscribe links (global and per-show) 🔐 Protects the settings WebUI with optional HTTP Basic Auth 📧 All configuration (Plex, Tautulli, SMTP) is done in the Web UI
